title: Lipid Lab: Lipids — ItsDrDan
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: CHEM 3B lipids practice in 4 main options that reveal topics (students can mix several): Fatty Acids (saturated/mono/poly from drawn line structures and condensed formulas, cis or trans, omega numbers, tap the α, β and ω carbons, melting points and ranking, shorthand like 18:2, essential fatty acids), Fat Reactions (making fats and waxes by condensation, hydrolysis with acid or lipase, saponification and soap, hydrogenation and H2 counting, rancidity and trans fats), Lipid Families (name the family from a drawn structure: fatty acid, wax, triacylglycerol, glycerophospholipid, sphingolipid, steroid, eicosanoid, fat-soluble vitamin; hydrolyzable or not; steroids and hormones; eicosanoids and NSAIDs; vitamins A, D, E, K) and Membranes & Health (bilayer pictures, diffusion vs facilitated vs active transport with gradient diagrams, lipoproteins, statins, gallstones, lung surfactant, dental and nursing cases). Every structure is drawn by the game. Skill Check Prep: 10 questions, one per lipid learning goal, then a study plan. Final-exam review: Final Boss lipid questions. Mistake-specific feedback, step-by-step help, hints, a lipid reference sheet, XP, ranks, 10 achievements, a phospholipid mascot and ItsDrDan videos.
